title: CLI documentation updates
body: When changing CLI behavior, update commands.md, configuration.md when keys change, and the Unreleased changelog.

title: Conventional commit subjects
body: Commit subjects use Conventional Commits; do not add attribution trailers.

title: Contiguous numbered migrations
body: Ledger schema changes use the numbered embedded migrations returned by migrations(); append the next migration in sequence and keep the series contiguous.

title: Parity and transcript fixtures
body: The parity fixture guide documents where behavioral parity fixtures live and how expected outputs are maintained; update the fixture and its expected output together when parity behavior intentionally changes.

title: Targeted Rust tests
body: Rust workspace checks should target the affected package with cargo test -p and set CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0; avoid cargo clean because it discards shared build artifacts.

title: Plans are archived rather than deleted
body: Plans are archived rather than deleted; archive_plans and unarchive_plan preserve plan records while controlling archived visibility.

title: Operator floor list
body: approval_floor identifies actions an approval window never auto-approves, including force pushes, out-of-project deletes and controller restart; consult this key when changing approval policy.

title: Operator-only actions
body: Operator-only operations are separated from agent actions and require operator authorization; consult operator policy before exposing them to routed commands.

title: Prune cache without racing active users
body: prune and prune_with_hooks plan cache removals while taking entry locks and checking active process use; use prune APIs rather than deleting cache directories directly.

title: Resolve layered project configuration
body: parse_layered_config and parse_layered_config_with resolve base and overlay TOML into RoleConfig while preserving source-aware configuration errors; use these instead of parsing layers independently.

title: Check and record config trust
body: trust_status compares current config bytes with the per-user trust record; record_current and record_trust persist acceptance, while checked_subset identifies trusted key values.

title: Embedded ledger migration registry
body: migrations returns the ordered embedded Migration list and checksum computes its content digest; add schema upgrades to this numbered registry rather than bypassing migration tracking.

title: Open and migrate a ledger
body: open_database applies SQLite safety pragmas, runs embedded migrations and prunes migration backups after schema changes; use OpenOptions to tune cache, mmap, maintenance and backup retention.

title: Guard access to archived plans
body: table_present checks whether a ledger table exists, is_archived checks a plan archive record, and refuse_if_archived blocks mutation of archived plans; use these guards in plan operations.

title: Record package landings
body: record_package_landing and clear_package_landing persist package landing state; package_landings reads it and counts_for_signoff determines whether landing records satisfy a sign-off sequence.

title: Route CLI commands through daemon
body: is_routed identifies commands handled by the daemon; run_routed forwards them through the operator socket and access_of classifies command authorization.

title: Build controller status snapshot
body: status_snapshot assembles the kernel status response from ledger state; reuse it for status views rather than duplicating snapshot queries.

title: Reap scratch-directory processes
body: Use Reaper::new or kill_processes_in to SIGKILL processes whose cwd is inside a test scratch directory; Reaper runs on Drop, and short_temp_root keeps socket fixture paths short.

title: Call daemon over operator socket
body: transport::call sends one framed request over a fresh Unix socket and reads one bounded response line; WireError distinguishes NotSent from AfterSend, so callers must not retry an after-send operation blindly.

title: Retry safe wire requests
body: call_retrying assigns request IDs and retries transport failures using bounded jittered backoff; use it only with daemon operations whose request ID semantics make replay safe.

title: Validate Unix socket path length
body: check_socket_path compares path bytes with the platform sun_path limit and returns a diagnostic naming the path; call before binding or connecting sockets.
